DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ご注文を繰り返します。肉三皿と野菜一皿ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Let me repeat your order: three plates of meat and one plate of vegetables, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 少し待ってください。三人が別々に話したので、同じ肉を重ねて頼んだかもしれません。まだ厨房へ送らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 重複注文の可能性を説明し厨房への送信を止めてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please wait a moment. The three of us spoke separately, so we may have ordered the same meat twice. Please don't send the order to the kitchen yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that the order may contain a duplicate and ask them to hold off sending it to the kitchen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 承知しました。卓上のメモを一度まとめていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Certainly. Could you first consolidate the notes on the table?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 一人目と二人目が同じ一皿を指していました。肉は二皿、野菜は一皿です。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: メモを整理し肉二皿と野菜一皿へ修正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: The first and second people were referring to the same plate. We'd like two plates of meat and one plate of vegetables.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Sort out the notes and change the order to two plates of meat and one plate of vegetables. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 肉の二皿は、この二種類で合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Are these the two kinds of meat you want?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。塩味が一皿、たれ味が一皿です。たれ味を二皿にするという意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 塩味とたれ味は各一皿でたれ二皿ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. One plate seasoned with salt and one with sauce. I don't mean two plates with sauce.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that you want one salt-seasoned plate and one with sauce, rather than two with sauce. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: それぞれ一皿ですね。ご飯は三つでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: One of each, then. Would you like three bowls of rice?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ご飯は二つです。私は今は食べないので、三人だから三つとは数えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 自分は不要なのでご飯は人数より少ない二つと指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Two bowls of rice, please. I'm not having any now, so please don't assume we want three just because there are three of us.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Specify two bowls of rice, fewer than the number of people, because you don't need one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 肉二皿、野菜一皿、ご飯二つで確定してよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: May I confirm two plates of meat, one plate of vegetables, and two bowls of rice?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: その内容でお願いします。追加するときは、私が代表して数を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 確定内容を承認し追加は代表で数を伝えると申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: Yes, please go ahead with that. If we order anything extra, I'll give you the quantities on everyone's behalf.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Approve the final order and offer to state the quantities on everyone's behalf for any additions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: では、この内容を厨房へ送ります。それでは、お食事をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll send that order to the kitchen now. Enjoy your meal.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 建物の材料について、ご興味がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Are you interested in the building materials?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この白い壁は昔から残っているのでしょうか。隣の柱と色が違って見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 壁が昔のままか柱との色の違いから尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Has this white wall survived from the old days? It looks a different color from the pillar beside it.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether the wall is original, noting its different color from the pillar. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 壁は修復の際に作り直した部分です。柱には古い部材が使われています。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: This part of the wall was rebuilt during restoration. The pillar uses old timber.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 全部が同じ時代のものではないのですね。壁の新しさだけで、家全体が新しいとは書かないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 修復壁と古材柱を分け家全体を新築扱いしないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: So not everything dates from the same period. I'll be careful not to write that the whole house is new just because the wall is newer.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Distinguish the restored wall from the old timber pillar and say you won't describe the entire house as newly built. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 修復した位置は、こちらの見取り図に斜線で示しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: The restored areas are marked with diagonal lines on this floor plan.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 図の斜線が壁の位置と合っています。柱のところには斜線がないので、古い部材の区画ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 図の斜線を壁と対応させ柱の区画を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: The diagonal lines on the plan match the wall's location. There are none at the pillar, so that's the section with the old materials.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Match the diagonal lines on the plan to the wall and confirm the pillar's section. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ただし、図は材料のすべての細かい年代を示したものではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: However, the plan doesn't show the precise age of every material.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 柱が何年の木かまでは、この図だけでは分からないのですね。見学メモには、古い部材とだけ書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 柱の細かな年代は図だけで分からず古材とだけ書く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: So this plan alone doesn't tell us exactly what year the pillar's timber is from. I'll just note that it's old timber.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that the plan alone doesn't establish the pillar's precise age and you'll only note that it's old timber. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 詳しい説明は、出口の解説冊子にもあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: There's also a detailed explanation in the booklet at the exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 先にここで壁と柱を見比べてから、出口で冊子を探します。分かったことと年代が未確認のことを分けてメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 現物比較後に冊子を探し確認済みと未確認年代を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll compare the wall and pillar here first, then look for the booklet at the exit. I'll keep confirmed observations separate from dates I haven't verified in my notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Compare the actual materials before finding the booklet, and keep confirmed facts separate from unverified dates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: ぜひ違いをご覧ください。それでは、引き続き見学をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: Please do take a look at the differences. Enjoy the rest of your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 道路で危ない場所を見つけられたのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: You found a dangerous spot on the road, is that right?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 歩道の端に四角い穴があり、ふたがありませんでした。新聞紙で覆おうかと思いましたが、穴が見えなくなるので何も置かず知らせに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 歩道端のふたなし穴を新聞紙で覆わず報告に来たと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: There was a square hole at the edge of the sidewalk with no cover. I considered covering it with newspaper, but that would hide the hole, so I left it uncovered and came to report it.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Report the uncovered hole at the sidewalk's edge and say you didn't cover it with newspaper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 場所はどの辺りですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 橋の手前の歩道です。自転車置き場の入口の横で、車道ではありません。地図で示せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 橋手前の駐輪場入口横の歩道で車道ではないと場所を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: It's on the sidewalk just before the bridge, beside the entrance to the bicycle parking area, not in the roadway. I can point it out on a map.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Locate it on the sidewalk beside the bicycle parking entrance before the bridge, not in the roadway. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 穴をのぞいたり、中へ入ったりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Did you peer into the hole or go inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: していません。落ちた物を探しているわけでもありません。穴の深さを測るために手を入れることもしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: のぞかず中へ入らず深さを測ろうともしていないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: No. I'm not looking for something I dropped, either. I haven't put my hand in to measure how deep it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Answer that you haven't peered in, entered, or tried to measure its depth. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 周囲を歩く人が避けられる場所でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Was there room for pedestrians to walk around it?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 歩道の幅は残っていましたが、二人が並ぶと穴の近くを通ります。自分の荷物を置いて人を車道へ誘導することはしませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 並んで歩くと穴に近づく幅を説明し荷物で車道へ誘導しなかったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: There was still some sidewalk width available, but two people walking side by side would pass close to the hole. I didn't put my belongings down to divert people into the roadway.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that people walking side by side would pass near the hole and that you didn't use your belongings to divert them into the road. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 分かりました。こちらで場所を確認します。何か目印はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. We'll check the location. Is there a landmark?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 青い自転車置き場の看板です。穴を自分で埋めたり、別の場所のふたを持って来たりせず、この位置をお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 青い駐輪場看板を目印にし自分で埋めたりふたを移したりしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: There's a blue bicycle parking sign. Rather than filling the hole myself or bringing a cover from somewhere else, I'll show you its location.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Give the blue bicycle parking sign as a landmark and say you won't fill the hole yourself or move another cover. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 目印まで分かりました。それでは、お知らせいただきありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: We have the landmark as well now. Thank you for letting us know. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今日の配置表を見て、自分の担当を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please check today's assignment chart to see what you're responsible for.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 私の名前が昨日の表にはありましたが、今日の表にはありません。昨日と同じ持ち場へ行く前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 本日の配置表に自分の名前がなく昨日の持ち場へ行く前に聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: My name was on yesterday's chart, but it isn't on today's. I'd like to check before going to the same station as yesterday.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say your name is missing from today's chart and ask before going to yesterday's station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 昨日は資材の受け取り補助でしたね。今日は担当を変更する予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yesterday you helped receive materials, didn't you? We're planning to change your assignment today.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: そうです。荷下ろしの担当者が私を待っているかもしれないので、変更をその方にも伝えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 昨日の受取補助担当へ変更連絡も頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: That's right. The person in charge of unloading may be waiting for me, so could you let them know about the change too?
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask them to also notify the person in charge of yesterday's receiving work about the reassignment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 私から伝えます。今日は休憩所の備品確認を頼みます。資材の受け取りには入りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll let them know. Today I'd like you to check the supplies in the break area. You won't be receiving materials.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今日は備品確認ですね。資材の数量を数える仕事とは別だと分かりました。確認する一覧はどれでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 備品確認は資材数量確認と別だと理解し一覧を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll be checking supplies today, then. I understand that's separate from counting material quantities. Which checklist should I use?
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Confirm that checking supplies is different from checking material quantities and ask for the list. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらの備品一覧です。見当たらない物は、なしと断定せず私に場所を聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Use this supplies list. If you can't find something, ask me where it is rather than concluding we don't have it.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 見える棚だけで欠品と書かないようにします。一覧と置き場が合わないものは、名前を控えて尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 見える棚だけで欠品と断定せず不一致の品名を控えて聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I won't mark an item as missing just from looking at the visible shelves. If something doesn't match the list and storage locations, I'll note its name and ask.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you won't conclude that an item is missing based only on visible shelves, and will note mismatched items and ask. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 表にもあなたの担当を書き加えます。確認結果は朝の作業後に報告してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll add your assignment to the chart too. Report your findings after the morning work.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 担当が記入されたのを見ました。備品一覧を持って休憩所へ行き、結果をまとめて戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 担当追記を確認して一覧とともに休憩所へ向かい報告すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: I've seen the assignment added. I'll take the supplies list to the break area and come back with the results organized.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Confirm the added assignment, say you'll take the list to the break area, and report back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: お願いします。それでは、朝の確認後にまた会いましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: Thank you. I'll see you again after the morning checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらの箱の修理をご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Would you like this box repaired?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ふたが最後まで入りません。昨日外して拭いた後からなので、削って直す前に向きが合っているか見てほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 拭いた後閉まらないふたを削る前に向き確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: The lid won't go all the way in. It's been like that since I removed and wiped it yesterday, so before shaving anything off, I'd like you to check whether it's facing the right way.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask to check the lid's orientation before shaving it, since it stopped closing after you wiped it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ふたの裏に小さな丸の印があります。箱の内側にも同じ印はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: There's a small circle on the underside of the lid. Is there the same mark inside the box?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 内側の短い辺に丸があります。今はふたの丸が長い辺に向いていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 箱とふたの丸印が異なる辺へ向いていると報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: There's a circle on the short side inside. At the moment, the lid's circle was facing the long side.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Report that the circle marks on the box and lid are facing different sides. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 印が同じ側に来るよう、ふたを回して確かめてみましょう。無理に押し込まないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Let's turn the lid so the marks are on the same side and check it. Please don't force it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 回すと途中まで自然に入ります。押し込まず、残りの部分はそちらで見ていただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 回したら自然に入るが押し込まず職人に残りを見てもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: When I turn it, it slides partway in naturally. I won't push it in; I'll leave you to check the rest.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say the lid now slides in naturally when turned, but you'll let the craftsperson check the rest without forcing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今はすき間なく収まりました。向きが違っていたようで、今回は削る必要がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: It now fits without a gap. It seems it was facing the wrong way, so there's no need to shave it this time.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 削らなくてよかったです。次に外すときは、丸の位置を写真に残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 削る必要がなく次に外す前は印の位置を写真に残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'm glad we didn't shave it. The next time I take it off, I'll photograph where the circle is.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say no shaving is needed and you'll photograph the mark's position before removing it next time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ふたを外した状態で運ぶ際は、箱とふたを別々にぶつけないよう包んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: If you transport it with the lid off, wrap the box and lid separately so they don't knock against anything.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 今日は閉じた状態で持ち帰ります。向きの印が消えないよう、裏を強くこすらないことも覚えておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 閉じた状態で持ち帰り裏の印を強くこすらないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll take it home closed today. I'll also remember not to scrub the underside hard, so I don't erase the orientation mark.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say you'll take it home closed and won't scrub the mark on the underside hard. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: では、このままお持ち帰りください。それでは、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: Please take it home as it is, then. Thank you very much.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お連れ様の分も、今から揚げ始めてよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: May we start frying your companion's portion now as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 友人から連絡があり、二十分ほど遅れるそうです。二人分を同時に出す予定でしたが、まだ変更できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 同行者が二十分遅れるため同時提供の変更が可能か聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: My friend contacted me and says they'll be about twenty minutes late. We planned to have both meals served together; can we still change that?
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether simultaneous service can be changed because your companion will be twenty minutes late. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: まだ揚げていません。お客様の分だけ先に出すか、二人分とも待つか選べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: We haven't started frying yet. We can serve just yours first or wait to prepare both.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 私の分だけ先にお願いします。友人の分を先に揚げて置いておく形にはしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 自分だけ先に揚げてもらい友人分の作り置きを望まないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please serve mine first. Please don't fry my friend's portion in advance and leave it sitting.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask to have only yours fried first, and say you don't want your friend's portion cooked ahead and held. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 承知しました。お連れ様の分は、到着後に揚げます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Certainly. We'll fry your companion's portion after they arrive.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 友人が来たときに声をかけます。ただ、私の食べ終わりに合わせて急いで出す必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 到着時に声をかけ自分の食べ終わりに合わせ急がせないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll let you know when my friend gets here. There's no need to rush their meal to match when I finish mine, though.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you'll notify them when your friend arrives and they needn't rush to match when you finish eating. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 通常の順番でご用意します。ご飯と汁物は、ご自身の分だけ今お出ししますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: We'll prepare it in the usual order. Shall we bring just your rice and soup now?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、私の分だけです。友人の席へ料理を置かないようにお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: ご飯汁物も自分だけ今受け取り友人席へは置かないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, just mine, please. Please don't put any food at my friend's place.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask to receive only your own rice and soup now, with nothing placed at your friend's seat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらの一人分を先にご用意します。お連れ様の注文内容は変えませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: We'll prepare this one portion first. Your companion's actual order remains unchanged, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 内容はそのままです。到着したら友人にも、これから揚げてもらうと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 注文内容は変えず友人へ到着後調理と知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: The order is unchanged. When my friend arrives, I'll explain that their food will be fried from then.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say the order remains the same and you'll tell your friend that cooking begins after arrival. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、まずお客様のお食事をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: Certainly. Please enjoy your meal first, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ご注文の前菜を、お一人分の小皿でお持ちしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Here is your ordered appetizer, on a small plate for one person.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この小皿に入った前菜は、二人で取り分けるものですか。注文した大皿の料理と分けておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 注文済み前菜の小皿が二人の取り分け用か尋ね大皿と区別したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Is this appetizer on the small plate for the two of us to share? I'd like to keep it separate from the large-platter dish we ordered.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether the ordered appetizer on the small plate is for two to share and distinguish it from the large platter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 料理の入った皿は最初にお出しする一人分です。取り分けには、別の空皿をご用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: The plate with food is the individual portion we serve first. We'll bring separate empty plates for sharing.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 料理入りは一人分なのですね。友人と半分ずつ分ける大皿だと思っていました。空皿を二枚いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 一人分と理解し二枚の空皿を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: So the plate with food is for one person. I thought it was a platter for my friend and me to split. Could we have two empty plates?
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that it's one portion and ask for two empty plates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。今の小皿は、人数分それぞれお持ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Certainly. We'll bring one of these small plates for each person.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 分かりました。友人の分が来るまで、私の小皿から取り分けなくてよいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 友人分が別に来るので自分の小皿から分けなくてよいと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. So I don't need to share from my small plate while waiting for my friend's portion.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Confirm that your friend's portion will come separately, so you needn't share your own small plate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: そうです。空皿は中央へ置きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: That's right. Shall I put the empty plates in the middle?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 中央だと大皿を置く場所がなくなるので、それぞれの席の右側に置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 大皿の中央スペースを空け取り皿を各席右へ頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: That would leave no room for the large platter, so please put one to the right of each place.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Leave the center clear for the large platter and request a sharing plate to the right of each seat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 右側に一枚ずつ置きました。大皿は、空いた中央へお持ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I've put one on each right-hand side. We'll bring the large platter to the space in the center.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。自分用の小皿は手前、取り分け用は右へ分けて、友人にも説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 個人小皿と右の取り皿を分け友人へ用途を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: Thank you. I'll keep my individual small plate in front of me and the sharing plate to the right, and explain that to my friend too.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Keep the individual plate separate from the sharing plate on the right and explain their uses to your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: ごゆっくりどうぞ。それでは、次のお料理を準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: Please enjoy yourselves. I'll prepare the next dish now.

DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの前方の席が空いています。
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-01.translation: These seats at the front are available.

DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 紙袋に贈り物を入れているので、水がかかる席は避けたいです。前方と後方で違いはありますか。
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 贈物の紙袋を濡らしたくなく前後席の水の違いを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm carrying a gift in a paper bag, so I'd like to avoid a seat where it might get splashed. Is there a difference between the front and back?
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about splashing at front and rear seats because you don't want the paper gift bag to get wet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 前方は水がかかる場合があります。後方でも、必ず濡れないとはお約束できません。
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-03.translation: You may get splashed at the front. Even at the back, we can't promise you'll stay completely dry.

DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 後方なら絶対安心というわけではないのですね。紙袋を持ったまま前へ進むのはやめます。
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 後方も濡れない保証はなく袋と前へ進むのをやめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the back isn't absolutely safe either. I'll stop heading forward with the paper bag.
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that rear seats aren't guaranteed dry and stop taking the bag forward. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋を濡らしたくなければ、場外の保管設備をご確認いただけます。
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you don't want the bag to get wet, you can check the storage facilities outside the venue.

DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会場から出て保管場所を探します。預けるか決める前に、袋が入る大きさか自分で確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 場外の保管設備を探し袋が入る大きさを確かめたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll leave the venue and look for storage. Before deciding to leave it there, I'd like to check for myself that the bag will fit.
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'll look for outside storage and check that the bag will fit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お戻りの際は、こちらの再入場案内をお読みください。開演時刻にもご注意ください。
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please read these re-entry instructions for when you return. Keep the starting time in mind too.

DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 再入場の表示を読んでから出ます。戻る時間が足りなければ、無理にこの回へ入らず次の案内を見ます。
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 再入場案内を読み時間不足なら次の回の案内を見る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll read the re-entry information before leaving. If I won't have enough time to return, I won't try to squeeze into this session; I'll check the information for the next one.
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Read the re-entry instructions and, if time is short, check the next session instead. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 保管設備の通路は右の出口からです。場内の通路に袋を置いておかないでください。
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-09.translation: The passage to the storage facilities is through the exit on the right. Please don't leave the bag in an aisle inside.

DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 紙袋は持って右へ出ます。空席に置いて場所を取ることもしません。
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 袋を持って右出口へ向かい通路や空席へ残さないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take the paper bag with me and leave through the right-hand exit. I won't leave it on an empty seat to reserve a place either.
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll take the bag through the right exit without leaving it in an aisle or on an empty seat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、それでは、またのご入場をお待ちしています。
DLG-SC-MIE-TOBA-001-SHARED-11.translation: All right. We look forward to welcoming you back.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お忘れ物のご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a lost item?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 忘れ物を探しているのではありません。さっきの船で借りた毛布を肩に掛けたまま降りたので、返したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 忘れ物捜索ではなく船内で借りた毛布の返却相談と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm not looking for lost property. I got off the boat just now still wearing the blanket I borrowed over my shoulders, and I'd like to return it.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you're asking to return a blanket borrowed aboard the boat, rather than searching for lost property. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お客様ご自身の持ち物ではなく、船内の貸出品なのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: So it's an item lent out on board, rather than something of your own.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。自分の鞄はこちらです。毛布だけが貸出品で、返す箱が見つからないからといって置いて帰るのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の鞄と貸出毛布を区別し返却箱がなくても放置しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. This is my own bag. Only the blanket is borrowed, and I don't want to just leave it behind because I can't find a return box.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish your own bag from the borrowed blanket and say you won't abandon it even if there's no return box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 乗った船の名前と、到着した時刻を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Could you tell me the boat's name and what time it arrived?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 船名は券に書いてあるこの名前で、十時に着いた便です。別の船の係員へ渡す前に、返す先を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 券で船名と十時到着便を示し別船へ渡す前に返却先を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The boat's name is this one on the ticket, and it was the service that arrived at ten. I'd like to confirm where to return it before handing it to staff from another boat.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the boat's name on the ticket and its ten o'clock arrival, and confirm the return destination before giving it to another boat's staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その便の担当へ私から連絡します。お客様は立入制限のある桟橋へ戻らず、ここでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll contact the person responsible for that service. Please wait here rather than returning to the restricted pier.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここで待ちます。まだ船が見えていても、自分で乗り直して客席へ戻すことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 窓口で待ち見えている船へ無断で戻らないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll wait here. Even though I can still see the boat, I won't board it again myself to put the blanket back in the passenger area.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll wait at the counter and won't return to the visible boat without permission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当がこちらへ受け取りに来ます。毛布を畳んでお持ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member will come here to collect it. Could you fold the blanket and keep it with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 畳んで手元に持ちます。椅子やごみ箱に置かず、受け取りに来た担当者へ直接渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 毛布を畳んで手元に置き受取担当へ直接渡すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll fold it and hold on to it. I won't put it on a chair or in a bin; I'll hand it directly to the staff member who comes to collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll fold and keep the blanket with you and hand it directly to the collecting staff member. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。それでは、担当が来るまでお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Please wait until the staff member arrives. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 次の荷のために、空箱をそろえてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you get the empty boxes ready for the next load?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 空箱の一つに昨日の便の札が残っています。今朝の魚を入れた箱と誤解されそうなので、使用前に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 空箱の昨日便札が今朝の荷と誤認されるおそれを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: One empty box still has a tag from yesterday's shipment. It might be mistaken for a box containing this morning's fish, so I'm reporting it before we use it.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the risk that yesterday's tag on an empty box may be mistaken for this morning's load. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その箱には、今朝の魚を入れましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you put this morning's fish in that box?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ何も入れていません。空の状態で台の左にあります。札には昨日の日付が読めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 魚をまだ入れず台左の空箱で昨日の日付が読めると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Nothing has gone in it yet. It's empty, to the left of the workbench. Yesterday's date is still legible on the tag.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it hasn't held any fish yet, is empty to the left of the bench, and yesterday's date is legible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日はその箱を使わず、こちらで表示と箱の状態を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Don't use that box today; we'll check the labeling and the box's condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 確認する箱は左の一つですね。残りの空箱まで全部使えないという意味かと思ったので、範囲を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 使用待ちは左の一箱か全箱か範囲を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: The box to check is the one on the left, right? I wondered whether you meant none of the other empty boxes could be used either, so I'd like to clarify the scope.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether only the box on the left is on hold or all boxes are. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 札が残った一つだけ待ってください。ほかの箱は、指定の点検を終えてからそろえます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Hold just the one with the old tag. Get the other boxes ready after completing the specified inspections.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ほかの箱も、空だから点検済みとは扱わないようにします。点検を終えた列へ勝手に混ぜません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他の空箱も未点検のまま点検済み列へ混ぜないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't treat the other boxes as inspected just because they're empty either. I won't mix them into the inspected row on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you won't mix the other empty boxes into the inspected row while they remain uninspected. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 古い札の取り外しは、担当から指示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person responsible will give instructions about removing the old tag.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分で札を剥がして確認を終えたことにはせず、左の箱を示して担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 札を自己判断で剥がさず箱を示し担当へ引き継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't peel off the tag myself and consider the check finished. I'll point out the box on the left and hand it over to the person responsible.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you won't remove the tag on your own judgment and will point out the box and hand it over. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お願いします。それでは、表示の確認後にまた声をかけます。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-TOBA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do. I'll speak to you again once the labeling is checked. Excuse me.
